newsitem.title: UK: Russia's Novorossiisk crude pipeline shuts.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Novorossiisk crude pipeline shuts.

text.p: The crude pipeline feeding Russia's main oil export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea was closed on Monday because storage tanks at the port had reached capacity, a reliable shipping source said.
The 650,000 barrel a day (bpd) port had been closed on and off for bad weather since Monday December 23, the shipper said.
"Ullage is full and they've shut the pipeline," the shipping company official said.
"The port has been closed for most of the time since Christmas Eve," she said.
Only one tanker, the 60,000 tonne Osam, has loaded since Christmas.
Novorossiisk's crude pipeline was shut on December 19 for maintenance work, and reopened on December 24.
The Black Sea terminal's loading berth one was brought back in to service on December 25 after a 17 day shutdown for repairs.
